entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-29
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [NativeAOT] ILCompiler - WinUI - Specified cast is not valid #122055
  • [RuntimeAsync] Runtime Async may not honor ExecutionContext.SuppressFlow(). #122052
    11.0.0
  • [RuntimeAsync] Assert !isCallConv(callConv, IMAGE_CEE_CS_CALLCONV_LOCAL_SIG) #122050
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix IndexOutOfRangeException in ILVerify for invalid exception handler offsets #122056
  • Update Ping.Windows.cs for async task handling #122054
    NO-MERGE, area-System.Net, community-contribution

    area-Infrastructure

Merged

  • Fold Span.Slice(X) like bound checks #122040
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Add GC heap hard limit for 32 bit #101024
    area-GC-coreclr, community-contribution

Updated

  • Simplify Uri's CreateHelper #122002
    area-System.Net, 11.0.0

    area-System.Memory, community-contribution

    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution

    area-VM-coreclr, 11.0.0
